roles.roleTitle: Natural resource and environmental programme manager
roles.functionStatement: Keep an environmental or natural resource programme funded, lawful, staffed and able to deliver its decisions over budget and policy cycles.

instruments.label: FY2026 Interior, Environment and Related Agencies appropriations (P.L. 119-74, Division C)
Rescission of unobligated IRA conservation and staffing funds (P.L. 119-21)
Good Neighbor Authority incl. EXPLORE Act amendments

bands.indicativeBand: GS-12 to GS-13 (senior); GS-13 to GS-14 (lead); GS-14 to GS-15 (strategic)

majorDuties.duty: Formulate, justify and execute public budgets across appropriations cycles

tasks.statement: Prepare a program budget request and justification linking each funding increment to outputs and outcomes the budget office can verify
Reconcile program obligations and expenditures against appropriations, agreements and fee accounts each month, flagging any use outside purpose or period
Prepare a continuing-resolution and funding-lapse contingency plan, ranking program activities by legal requirement and consequence of delay
Brief appropriations staff or a governing board on a program budget request, answering questions with figures traceable to the justification
Design a fee or cost-recovery schedule for a permit or service program within its statutory authority, documenting the cost basis for each fee

majorDuties.duty: Brief decision-makers and elected officials for authoritative decisions

tasks.statement: Write a decision memo for an accountable official, stating the decision required, options, evidence, risks and a recommendation within two pages
Brief a decision-maker orally on a pending decision under time pressure, answering questions and stating where the evidence is uncertain
Prepare a staff report for a governing body's public meeting, stating findings, options and the legal basis for each recommended action
Advise an official in writing when the evidence does not support a preferred option, recording the advice given in the decision file

majorDuties.duty: Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands

tasks.statement: Coordinate an interdisciplinary team drafting a forest, range or refuge management plan, assigning plan components and reconciling conflicting resource objectives
Write plan components such as desired conditions, objectives, standards and monitoring questions so that later projects can show consistency with them

majorDuties.duty: Design and administer cross-jurisdictional stewardship agreements

tasks.statement: Draft a memorandum of understanding or interagency agreement that assigns shared responsibilities, resources and decision rights for a joint program
Monitor an agreement's deliverables, invoices and revenue ledger against its terms, amending the agreement when scope or partners change

majorDuties.duty: Assess the durability and reversal risk of policy choices and time actions to policy windows

tasks.statement: Assess the reversal risk of a program's key instruments, recording the evidence, the likely triggers and a contingency for each high-risk instrument
Advise leadership on the choice and timing of an instrument for a new policy, comparing the durability, speed and litigation exposure of each option
Classify each instrument a program relies on by type and the process needed to change it, recording who can change it and how quickly

majorDuties.duty: Design developmental work experiences that preserve the formation of professional judgment

tasks.statement: Analyze a workflow to identify which entry-level tasks form judgment and which of them AI tools or automation now perform
Advise leadership on the formation consequences of adopting an AI tool before deployment, naming the alternative formation route required
Plan rotations and mentored field assignments that give entry staff graduated exposure to the conditions their role must handle

majorDuties.duty: Navigate legislative and governing-body processes for environmental programs

tasks.statement: Track bills, ordinances and appropriations measures affecting the program, summarizing each relevant provision's effect on program operations
Prepare testimony or a briefing for a legislative committee or governing board, stating the program's technical position and its evidence

majorDuties.duty: Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance

tasks.statement: Write a dated change notice explaining what a new rule, guidance or court decision changes for staff, its effective dates and the work in progress it affects
Train staff on a significant regulatory change, testing their application of the new requirement on sample cases

majorDuties.duty: Elicit, document and transfer tacit and institutional knowledge before people leave

tasks.statement: Identify knowledge held by one or a few people in a unit by rating its criticality and its risk of loss
Prepare a handover record of open commitments, contacts, site conditions and decision history for a transferred assignment

majorDuties.duty: Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements

tasks.statement: Review a proposed agreement for compliance with procurement, grant and cross-cutting requirements before signature, listing each deficiency and its correction

majorDuties.duty: Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality

tasks.statement: Review project progress against the baseline at each reporting period to decide corrective actions

majorDuties.duty: Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios

tasks.statement: Report data and AI value and risk measures for the organization's portfolio to executives, recommending investment and retirement decisions.
Set governance rules that keep consequential AI-assisted decisions with accountable people and that weigh affected communities' input on AI priorities.

majorDuties.duty: Specify, evaluate and accept AI and analytics services in procurement

tasks.statement: Write technical requirements and acceptance tests for an AI or analytics service before solicitation, tied to a local evaluation set.

majorDuties.duty: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings

tasks.statement: Design a unit learning-from-incidents process that links reporting channels, review triggers and pre-work briefing content

majorDuties.duty: Apply systems thinking across ecological, institutional and technical systems

tasks.statement: Compare alternative interventions on a system map to identify leverage points and trade-offs for decision-makers

majorDuties.duty: Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards

tasks.statement: Certify a candidate's qualification for a position from the completed performance record, evaluator ratings and currency evidence

majorDuties.duty: Develop proposals and grant applications for environmental work

tasks.statement: Decide whether to pursue a funding or contract opportunity using a documented assessment of fit, capacity and competition

knowledgeStatements: A by-hand quota is a set number of unaided work products a learner completes before review-and-certify credit, sized so the learner can recognize the tool's characteristic errors.
A formation task is an entry-level task with high or medium tacit content through which practitioners historically built the judgment needed to check later work, including AI output.
Practice with unguarded AI assistance can raise practice-task scores while lowering later unaided performance, so formation is assessed with at least one AI-off component.
